rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: palms only - spaced palms on the promenade and the median (zone 105 -> about 95)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's nineteen builder trees go (a coral and a magnolia by the car park, seventeen palms); the six palms of the grass strip between the promenade and the beach road come back on their own spots. The promenade row stood on the plaza with no well (the tree check refuses it) and stays out, as do the palms among the cottages and the flats' yards.
